description: INTACCR: ACCRUE INTEREST
ACCRUES EVERY ACCOUNT'S INTEREST FOR THE CALENDAR DAYS FROM
ITS LAST ACCRUAL UP TO THE BUSINESS DATE, ON THE OPENING
BALANCE: THE BALANCE THE LAST BUSINESS DAY CLOSED WITH, WHICH
STOOD OVER THE DAYS IN BETWEEN. THE RATE IS THE ACCOUNT
TYPE'S HIGHEST CREDIT TIER THE BALANCE REACHES, OR ITS DEBIT
RATE BELOW ZERO. A YEAR HAS 365 DAYS.
WHEN THE DAYS CROSS INTO A NEW MONTH, THE DAYS OF THE OLD
MONTH ARE ACCRUED FIRST AND ITS INTEREST BECOMES DUE, ROUNDED
TO THE CENT, TO BE CREDITED OR CHARGED. THE ACCRUALS ARE READ
IN STEP WITH THE MASTER, ONE FOR EACH ACCOUNT. AN ACCOUNT
OPENED SINCE THE LAST RUN HAS NONE YET AND STARTS ACCRUING
TODAY.
RETURN CODES: 0 ACCRUED,
16 AN ACCRUAL FOR NO ACCOUNT, NO RATE, OR I/O.
MODIFICATION HISTORY

1202       FIB INTEREST BY THE DAY, IN THE LIBER ABACI, PISA.
2001-09-03 TL  CR-0298 IN COBOL.
2002-02-11 TL  CR-0311 ACCOUNTS OPENED SINCE THE LAST RUN.

records.name: BANK-CONTROL-RECORD
records.description: BANKCTL: BANK CONTROL RECORD, ONE PER FILE THE BUSINESS DATE THE BATCH RUNS FOR, NEVER THE CLOCK.

records.name: RATE-RECORD
records.description: RATEREC: INTEREST RATE TABLE RECORD, 20 BYTES ONE RECORD PER RATE: CREDIT RATES IN TIERS BY BALANCE, ONE DEBIT RATE FOR BALANCES BELOW ZERO, PER ACCOUNT TYPE. A BALANCE EARNS THE RATE OF THE HIGHEST TIER IT REACHES, ON THE WHOLE BALANCE. RATES ARE ANNUAL FRACTIONS: 0.015 IS 1.5%. MODIFICATION HISTORY DATE       BY  CHANGE -1754      HAM ORIGINAL VERSION, ON CLAY, IN BABYLON: AT MOST 20% A YEAR ON SILVER, 33 1/3% ON GRAIN. 2001-09-03 TL  CR-0298 IN COBOL, WITH TIERS. GRAIN DROPPED.

records.name: ACCT-MASTER-RECORD
records.description: ACCTMAST: ACCOUNT MASTER RECORD, 100 BYTES IN ACCOUNT NUMBER ORDER. THE BALANCE MAY GO BELOW ZERO DOWN TO THE OVERDRAFT LIMIT, AND BELOW THAT ONLY BY FEES. MODIFICATION HISTORY DATE       BY  CHANGE 1987-03-12 JA  ORIGINAL VERSION. 1994-11-14 PK  CR-0201 OVERDRAFT LIMIT, FROM THE FILLER. 1999-01-11 SL  Y2K: 8-DIGIT DATES.

records.name: WS-ACCRUAL-KEY
records.description: THE ACCOUNT NUMBER OF THE NEXT ACCRUAL: HIGH-VALUES AT THE END.

records.name: ACCRUAL-RECORD
records.description: ACCRREC: INTEREST ACCRUAL RECORD, 40 BYTES ONE PER ACCOUNT, IN ACCOUNT NUMBER ORDER LIKE THE MASTER. INTEREST IS ACCRUED FOR EVERY CALENDAR DAY BEFORE THE THROUGH DATE, TO SIX DECIMALS, AND IS NEGATIVE FOR AN OVERDRAWN BALANCE. WHEN A MONTH CLOSES, ITS INTEREST BECOMES DUE, ROUNDED TO THE CENT; THE FRACTION STAYS ACCRUED. THE DUE MONTH IS ZERO ON THE DAYS NO MONTH CLOSES. MODIFICATION HISTORY DATE       BY  CHANGE 2001-09-03 TL  CR-0298 ORIGINAL VERSION.

records.name: WS-RATE-COUNT
records.description: THE RATE TABLE, AS MANY RATES AS THE RATE FILE HOLDS.

records.name: WS-ACCOUNT-RATE
records.description: THE RATE FOR THE ACCOUNT IN HAND, AND THE TIER IT CAME FROM.

records.name: WS-TODAY
records.description: DAYS COUNT FROM 1601-01-01, AS FUNCTION INTEGER-OF-DATE GIVES.

records.name: WS-MONTH-START
records.description: THE FIRST DAY OF THE MONTH AFTER THE LAST ACCRUAL.

records.name: WS-INTEREST-PRODUCT
records.description: THE BALANCE TIMES THE RATE TIMES THE DAYS, EXACT, BEFORE IT IS DIVIDED BY THE DAYS OF A YEAR AND ROUNDED.

paragraphs.name: 1000-INITIALIZE
paragraphs.description: OPEN THE FILES, LOAD THE RATES AND READ THE FIRST ACCOUNT.

paragraphs.name: 1100-LOAD-RATES
paragraphs.description: READ THE RATE FILE INTO THE RATE TABLE.

paragraphs.name: 1400-TAKE-ACCRUAL
paragraphs.description: TAKE THE ACCOUNT'S ACCRUAL, OR START ONE FOR AN ACCOUNT OPENED SINCE THE LAST RUN: NOTHING ACCRUED, THROUGH TODAY.

paragraphs.name: 2000-ACCRUE-ACCOUNT
paragraphs.description: ACCRUE ONE ACCOUNT UP TO THE BUSINESS DATE. IF A MONTH CLOSED ON THE WAY, ACCRUE ITS DAYS FIRST AND MAKE ITS INTEREST DUE.

paragraphs.name: 2100-FIND-RATE
paragraphs.description: FIND THE ACCOUNT'S RATE: BELOW ZERO THE DEBIT RATE OF ITS TYPE, OTHERWISE THE CREDIT RATE OF THE HIGHEST TIER IT REACHES.

paragraphs.name: 2110-TAKE-RATE
paragraphs.description: TAKE THE RATE IN HAND AS THE ACCOUNT'S, SO FAR.

paragraphs.name: 2200-FIND-MONTH-START
paragraphs.description: THE FIRST DAY OF THE MONTH AFTER THE THROUGH DATE.

paragraphs.name: 2300-ACCRUE-DAYS
paragraphs.description: ACCRUE THE OPENING BALANCE AT THE ACCOUNT'S RATE FOR THE DAYS.

paragraphs.name: 2400-CLOSE-MONTH
paragraphs.description: MAKE THE CLOSED MONTH'S INTEREST DUE, TO THE CENT, AND KEEP THE FRACTION ACCRUED.

paragraphs.name: 9900-ABORT
paragraphs.description: STOP THE RUN WITH RETURN CODE 16, SAYING WHY.
